assay_conditions.calculation: HC50 divided by lowest MIC or lowest IC50 as defined in Table 6 caption
assay_conditions.source_table_caption: Selectivity indexes (SIs) of analogs. SIs were calculated by dividing the HC50 value (in µM, from Table 5) of each analog by its lowest MIC value on micro-organisms (i.e., MIC values on B. subtilis for all peptides except for peptide 4 for which the MIC value on S. typhi was used) (in µM, from Table 4) or its lowest IC50 value on cancer cells (i.e., IC50 values on MCF-7 for peptides 1, 2, and 7 and on HeLa for peptides 3, 6, and 8) (in µM, from Table 5).
